verdict.rationale: LightSprint's own materials describe launching its agents in the cloud as background cloud agents. Each task gets an isolated sandbox, with a branched database when needed, and a live preview that needs no local setup. The vendor also says it automates environment setup, so developers do not run their own backend for agent execution. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of how the managed runtime works (concurrency limits, scaling behavior, resource quotas), independent or hands-on corroboration, and depth beyond marketing-page snippets.
